services: Real Edge, Keycloak, Next.js, Django, PostgreSQL

results.name: Real Site author access
results.details: Keycloak session and Site-scoped Posts administration loaded.

results.name: Formatted draft save
results.details: Browser formatting, safe paste, headings/lists/quote/link saved through real server actions.

results.name: Reopen preserves formatting
results.details: All supported semantic elements reload; unsafe pasted content cannot execute.

results.name: Two-session stale revision
results.details: Second editor save wins; stale author gets explicit conflict and retains unsaved text.

results.name: Discard warning
results.details: Cancel requires confirmation and dismiss preserves article.

results.name: Failed save retry
results.details: An interrupted server-action request displays a recoverable error, retains text and saves successfully on retry.

results.name: All formatting controls
results.details: H2, H3, H4, paragraph, quotation, unordered/ordered lists and emphasis controls operate on the selected article text.

results.name: Mobile keyboard
results.details: Article remains focusable at 390px; Ctrl+K opens accessible link dialog and Escape closes it.

results.name: Automated accessibility
results.details: No WCAG A/AA violations in the mobile editor dialog.

results.name: Anonymous public formatting
results.details: Existing public Post route renders the published H2, emphasis, list and quotation at mobile width.
